parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Ipv6Address
parameters.description:
One or more IPv6 addresses to allocate to the elastic network interface (ENI). You can set up to 10 IPv6 addresses. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

Example: Ipv6Address.1=2001:db8:1234:1a00::\*\*\*\*

> When you call this operation, you must set either the `Ipv6Addresses.N` parameter or the `Ipv6AddressCount` parameter, but not both.

parameters.name: Ipv6AddressCount
parameters.description:
The number of IPv6 addresses to randomly generate for the elastic network interface (ENI). Valid values: 1 to 10.

> When you call this operation, you must set either the `Ipv6Addresses.N` parameter or the `Ipv6AddressCount` parameter, but not both.

parameters.name: Ipv6Prefix
parameters.description:
One or more IPv6 prefixes to allocate to the elastic network interface (ENI). Valid values of N: 1 to 10.
> If you want to set IPv6 prefixes for the elastic network interface (ENI), you must specify either the Ipv6Prefix.N parameter or the Ipv6PrefixCount parameter, but not both.

parameters.name: Ipv6PrefixCount
parameters.description:
The number of IPv6 prefixes to allocate to the elastic network interface (ENI). Valid values: 1 to 10.
> If you want to set IPv6 prefixes for the elastic network interface (ENI), you must specify either the Ipv6Prefix.N parameter or the Ipv6PrefixCount parameter, but not both.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the elastic network interface (ENI).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the elastic network interface (ENI). You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
